Subject: POC recap + proposed success criteria / next steps

Hi Alex & Priya —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the POC so we’re all aligned: 

Summary / goals:
- Evaluate Redwood inference for product search reranking and personalization across 3 store segments.
- Success criteria (proposed): 10% CTR lift on personalized slots OR 8% reduction in irrelevant search results across test pages; average token latency <= 120ms for 512-token requests; no production PII leakage.

POC plan (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): access & sandbox ETA, data mapping, baseline metrics collected by Metropolis.
- Week 1–2: integration + run eval suite (we’ll provide a test harness).
- Week 3: analysis + decision point (go/no-go).

Ownership (proposed):
- Redwood: integration support, eval harness, model config recommendations (Dev + Ethan).
- Metropolis: provide sample data, baseline metrics, and product owner for evaluation (Alex / Priya).

Open items / asks:
1) Confirm success criteria above (Alex / Priya).
2) Share sample dataset and who on your side will own data delivery.
3) We’ll need security checklist signoff — are you okay with completing our quick questionnaire during week 0?

I’ve attached a short POC evaluation plan with timelines and checkpoints (POC_Eval_Plan_20261001.xlsx). Please let me know if anything is off and we’ll adjust. If that looks good I’ll ask Dev to spin up the sandbox and Ethan to schedule an integration call next week.

Best,

Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC recap + proposed success criteria / next steps

Hi all — quick update from our side after starting the ingestion of the sample dataset: we hit an intermittent issue where some records in the sandbox responses contained snippets of customer emails (e.g., order confirmations) in the generated outputs. That is a blocker for us — we need confirmation on the risk and an escalation path.

Details:
- Example: model returned a sentence referencing an order number and a customer email that was present in the sample data. We sanitized the dataset before sending but want to understand whether Redwood sandbox is pulling data from other tenants or if this is pattern leakage from model pretraining.
- Impact: blocks our ability to run the live eval — legal/compliance has paused the POC until this is resolved.

Can someone on Redwood confirm ownership of investigation and next steps + ETA? If we can’t get a mitigation this week, we’ll need to re-scope the POC.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Senior Data Product Manager
Metropolis Retail
priya.shah@metropolisretail.com

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@metropolisretail.com>, Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@metropolisretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC recap + proposed success criteria / next steps

Priya & Alex — thanks for the callout and really sorry for the disruption. Quick status and mitigation plan: 

Summary of investigation so far:
- Initial triage suggests the behavior is attributable to prompt-contamination in the eval harness and a subset of legacy test prompts that included verbatim examples. No evidence of cross-tenant data leakage from our runtime.
- We confirmed sandbox retention settings are isolated per-customer and there’s no shared S3 access between tenants.

Immediate mitigations (today):
1) We’ve disabled the legacy test prompts in the harness and replaced them with anonymized templates — you should see no examples with real PII (Completed).
2) Enabled response redaction filter to mask email addresses and order numbers in generated outputs for the POC run (Workaround in place).
3) We will run a full sweep of the sample dataset through our sanitization checker and provide a report (ETA: Wed 14 Oct).

Next steps / ownership: 
- Dev (me): complete sanitization sweep + redaction log by Wed 14 Oct; follow up with PoC report.
- Ethan: run a smoke integration test with Priya once sanitization is complete (ETA: Thu 15 Oct).
- Lauren: update the POC risk tracker and share a revised timeline with Metropolis (ETA: Thu 15 Oct).
- Marissa / Rishi: escalation contacts if legal needs further evidence — I’ll loop infra/ops if we see divergent findings.

Escalation path: 
- If sanitization reveals cross-tenant access (unlikely based on current checks) we will immediately pause the sandbox and schedule an incident review with Rishi + infra within 24 hours.
- Legal/Compliance requests: Marissa will coordinate; Rishi will own elevated incidents.

Attachments: PII_Mitigation_Workaround.md (contains the temporary redaction rules and command snippets).

Apologies again — we take these concerns seriously and will treat this as high priority until you’re comfortable resuming the eval. Happy to jump on a call today if helpful.

—Dev
Dev Patel
SRE / Integrations
Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
